text.en: eDiffi is row 88 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Diffusion Model Application area.
text.zh: eDiffi 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 88 行，所属领域为“扩散模型应用”。

text.en: The annual table associates eDiffi with “eDiffi: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with an Ensemble of Expert Denoisers”.
text.zh: 年度表把 eDiffi 与论文《eDiffi: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with an Ensemble of Expert Denoisers》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Yogesh Balaji, Ming-Yu Liu”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Yogesh Balaji（官方页拼写）、Ming-Yu Liu（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Yogesh Balaji, Ming-Yu Liu”。
